title: Cold Chain Monitoring
thesis: Snowflake monitors temperature compliance across the entire cold chain, detects anomalies predicting equipment failure, and auto-alerts logistics teams — replacing blind spots with real-time ML-powered cold chain intelligence

talking_points: Cold chain compliance rate: 94.2% — 47 trucks currently non-compliant.
Product loss from cold chain failures: ฿180M this quarter (spoilage + rejections).
Twelve compressor failures predicted in next 7 days (ML.FORECAST).
tabs.call_out: ฿180M product loss — 47 trucks non-compliant right now

2M readings ingested every 30 days — 5-minute resolution per asset.
